safe_zones.rule: Sean 2026-11-19: keep a safe margin on every design. His repost of the first GeekFon post zoomed in and cut off half the R in Roxanne's name tag and the end of 'Now playing' (the original on the GeekFon page was fine); asked whether to keep the margin plan, Logan: yes, every view frames the post differently. Words, faces, logos and graphics sit inside the safe area; only background may run to the edge. build_pack.py pad mode fits the source inside it, overlays are placed inside it, and `proof` draws it in red for the eye check.
safe_zones.why: The same post is framed differently in each place: reposts and shares zoom in, Instagram's profile grid crops posts and Reels covers to 3:4 (a 4:5 post loses about 34 px a side, a 9:16 Reel about 240 px top and bottom), Reels, TikTok and Shorts lay buttons on the right and the caption and audio line on the bottom, Stories put the profile row on top and the reply bar on the bottom, and Spotify lays track info on the bottom of the Canvas.
safe_zones.numbers: Logan working numbers, conservative on purpose; tighten only with a real cut-off to show for it.
